cordance-cordance:greenhouse:4994118008.title: Account Executive (Commerce & Compliance Divisions)
cordance-cordance:greenhouse:4994118008.description: Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential. We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy. Position Overview We are seeking a high-performing Account Executive specializing in commerce & compliance to drive new business growth across our compliance-oriented SaaS companies. You will engage organizations of all sizes, from small businesses to large enterprises operating in industries where regulatory adherence, workflow controls, and auditability are mission-critical . This role requires a disciplined, consultative seller skilled at uncovering risk exposure, mapping value to compliance outcomes, and engaging operational, legal, financial, and technical stakeholders throughout complex decision-making cycles. Key Responsibilities Identify and convert new logo opportunities across regulated industries (financial services, logistics, retail, manufacturing, government contractors, etc.). Build prospecting sequences targeting compliance officers, operational leaders, and risk managers. Use domain insight to articulate pain around governance, audit trails, policy compliance, and system-of-record accuracy. Manage qualification, discovery, presentations, proposals, and contract negotiation. Deliver compelling demos that emphasize workflow automation, compliance controls, and ROI. Run deep discovery to quantify risk exposure, process inefficiencies, and audit burdens. Align solutions to regulatory frameworks (SOC, ISO, SOX, GRC, internal audit mandates). Apply MEDDPICC to ensure disciplined deal management and forecasting accuracy. Maintain hubspot pipeline hygiene, forecast updates, and documentation. Partner with SDRs to refine ICP targeting across compliance-heavy segments. Collaborate with Marketing to shape vertical campaigns, compliance content, and case studies. Ensure smooth handoff to Customer Success for implementation and compliance onboarding. Navigate legal, procurement, and compliance review cycles. Structure deals that support long-term partnership and audit readiness. Competencies: Sales Execution & Strategy: Proven ability to own full-cycle SaaS sales in the mid-market segment, consistently achieving or exceeding quota. Balances disciplined process with creative deal strategy to accelerate new logo growth. Consultative Selling & Value Creation: Fluent in value-based discovery and business outcome alignment. Applies MEDDPICC rigor to qualify opportunities and advance deals efficiently. Relationship Development: Builds credibility and trust across multiple stakeholder levels — from functional leaders to executive sponsors — by acting as a strategic partner focused on business outcomes. Negotiation & Closing: Expert in crafting win-win deal structures that drive ARR growth while maintaining profitability and customer satisfaction. Operational Discipline: Maintains accurate forecasting, pipeline visibility, and CRM data hygiene. Prioritizes deals based on impact potential and alignment with ICP. Collaboration & Team Engagement: Partners effectively with SDRs, Sales Leadership, and Marketing to execute GTM strategies and ensure seamless transitions into post-sale success. Performance & Resilience: Operates with persistence, adaptability

cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:cbb.title: Senior Director, Performance Marketing
cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:cbb.description: Adventure is our Culture. Join a team that celebrates a lifestyle as bold as the terrain we love. At Backcountry, we are rooted in adventure, recognition, and wellbeing on and off the mountain. We spotlight employee stories, celebrate milestones, and offer exclusive outdoor perks. Whether you are at HQ, in a retail store, or remote, you will be part of a team that thrives on energy, exploration, and connection. Reports to: Senior Vice President, Marketing Location: Salt Lake City, Utah (Hybrid - 3x/week in-office)
responsibilities: Performance Marketing Strategy

Drive customer acquisition by owning the paid media strategy and roadmap across all four Backcountry banners — paid search, paid social, shopping/feed, display, affiliate, video/TV, and emerging channels.
Set channel and budget allocation based on incrementality, LTV, and blended CAC targets.
Translate company revenue and margin targets into a clear, prioritized paid media plan.
Execution and Team Leadership
Manage a team of 3 plus supporting agencies, setting standards for testing velocity, reporting rigor, and channel expertise.
Stay hands-on enough to review campaigns, audit account structure, and catch underperformance directly — this is not a fully delegated role.
Hold agency partners accountable to performance benchmarks, media efficiency, and clear scopes of work.
Own new channel expansion with hands-on execution of campaigns in new channels.
Build repeatable playbooks for launches, promotions, and seasonal peaks across the brand portfolio.
Run a continuous A/B and multivariate testing program across creative, landing pages, and audience targeting, turning results into scaled learnings.
Track competitor activity and market trends across the outdoor and active lifestyle space to spot new channels, formats, and positioning opportunities.
Leverage AI and automation tools to improve decisions, increase output, and maximize time spent on high-value tasks.
Cross-Functional Influence
Partner with Creative to ensure ad concepts and assets are built for performance from the start, not retrofitted after the fact.
Partner with Merchandising to align paid spend with inventory, margin, and assortment priorities.
Partner with eCommerce, Product, and Web Development to ensure landing pages, site experience, and conversion funnels support paid traffic quality.
Bring enough credibility and command of the numbers to influence functional leaders who do not report to you.
Executive Reporting and Accountability
Report directly to executive leadership on channel performance, budget efficiency, and growth opportunities.
Translate performance data into clear commercial recommendations — not just channel-level metrics.
Flag risks and opportunities early and bring solutions, not just problems.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
8+ years of experience in performance marketing or paid media, including 3+ years managing a team and agency relationships.
Proven ownership of a paid media budget spanning multiple channels (search, social, shopping/feed, display) with clear evidence of driving efficient growth.
Track record of working across multiple brands or business units simultaneously.
Strong command of performance marketing economics: CAC, LTV, incrementality, marginal ROAS, and blended efficiency.
Demonstrated ability to influence Creative, Merchandising, and eCommerce partners without direct authority over their teams.
Comfort operating at both the strategic and hands-on level — able to set the plan and personally dig into an account when needed.
Strong executive presence and communication skills, with experience reporting directly to senior leadership.
Demonstrated experience using AI tools and workflows to improve campaign performance, reporting, creative production, or team efficiency.
Hands-on proficiency with major ad platforms (Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager) and analytics/reporting tools (Google Analytics, Tableau, or Looker Studio).
Experience in outdoor, sporting goods, cycling, or active lifestyle ecommerce.
Experience with multi-brand or multi-site paid media management (shared team supporting several storefronts).

distro-distro:lever:307576e9-e6aa-4766-9.title: Spanish-English Interpreter/Translator
distro-distro:lever:307576e9-e6aa-4766-9.description: POSITION SUMMARY Unique Interpreters, LLC is seeking qualified Spanish-English Interpreters/Translators to provide remote, on-demand interpretation and document translation support for client engagements involving sensitive, trauma-informed conversations. Interpreters will support phone-based interpretation sessions, ensuring accurate, culturally sensitive, and confidential communication between English and Spanish speaking parties. This is a part-time, remote, independent contractor position ideal for experienced interpreters seeking flexible, meaningful work. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Provide accurate, real-time consecutive and/or simultaneous interpretation during phone sessions between English and Spanish speaking parties. Translate written documents, forms, and correspondence between English and Spanish as needed. Maintain strict confidentiality of all client, case, and personal information encountered during sessions. Interpret in a neutral, professional, and trauma-informed manner, particularly during sensitive conversations involving families and children. Accurately convey tone, intent, and cultural context without adding, omitting, or altering content. Maintain reliable availability for scheduled and on-demand interpretation sessions. Document session details (date, time, duration) for accurate billing and quality tracking. Communicate promptly with Unique Interpreters, LLC scheduling staff regarding availability, conflicts, or technical issues. Adhere to professional interpreter ethics standards, including accuracy, impartiality, and confidentiality. REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS Native or near-native fluency in both Spanish and English (verbal and written). Minimum of one year of professional interpretation and/or translation experience. Current interpreter certification required — one of the following: Certified Medical Interpreter (CMI), Certified Court Interpreter, National Board of Certification for Medical Interpreters (NBCMI), Certification Commission for Healthcare Interpreters (CCHI), or equivalent state/federal interpreter certification. Reliable high-speed internet connection, computer/smartphone, and headset suitable for remote interpretation. Ability to pass a background screening as required by client contracts. Strong professional communication skills and ability to maintain composure during emotionally sensitive conversations. Ability to work independently and manage a flexible, part-time schedule. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience interpreting in social services, child welfare, immigration, healthcare, or legal settings. Experience working with vulnerable populations, including families and minors. Availability for both scheduled sessions and short notice on-demand requests. Languages of particular value: English, Spanish, Haitian Creole, Hindi, Mandarin Chinese, Russian/Croatian. Compensation: $0.50 – $0.75 per minute of billable interpretation/translation time (based on experience and certification) #HireFinder #LI-PROMOTED #LI-Remote

gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:df7e531e-.title: Senior Data Engineer - MoneyLion
gendigital-gen-digital:ashbyhq:df7e531e-.description: About the Role The Kuala Lumpur office is the technology powerhouse of MoneyLion. We pride ourselves on innovative initiatives and thrive in a fast paced and challenging environment. Join our multicultural team of visionaries and industry rebels in disrupting the traditional finance industry! At MoneyLion, we measure everything and rely on data to guide our decisions, including both long-term strategies and day-to-day operations. As a Senior Data Engineer, your main goal is to support data scientists, analysts and software engineers by providing maintainable infrastructure and tooling they can use to deliver end-to-end solutions to business problems. You will work with terabytes to petabyte-scale data, in a complex data environment supporting multiple products and data stakeholders across the US and KL. You will be responsible for designing and implementing an analytical environment using in-house and third-party tools, using Python and/or Java to automate data activities and enable efficient processing of data that is growing in both volume and complexity. You will design and implement complex data pipelines and data models for analytical consumption. You will work with Redshift, Snowflake, EMR, Kubernetes, Airflow and more as the main tools of the job. You will write scalable and performant SQL queries running over billions of rows of data, and help simplify these processing to enable insights to be more easily extractable from them. You should have deep experience in designing and managing large datasets and pipelines to enable business use-cases. You should be an authority at designing, implementing and operating solutions that are scalable, stable and cost-efficient. Key Responsibilities - Design, implement, operate and improve the analytics platform - Design data solutions using various big data technologies and low latency architectures - Collaborate with data scientists, business analysts, product managers, software engineers and other data engineers to develop, implement and validate deployed data solutions. - Maintain the data warehouse with timely and quality data - Build and maintain data pipelines from internal databases and SaaS applications - Understand and implement data engineering best practices - Improve, manage, and teach standards for code maintainability and performance in code submitted and reviewed - Mentor and provide guidance to junior engineers on the job About You - Expert at writing and optimising SQL queries - Proficiency in Python, Java or similar languages - Familiarity with data warehousing concepts - Experience in Airflow or other workflow orchestrators - Familiarity with basic principles of distributed computing - Experience with big data technologies like Spark, Delta Lake or others - Proven ability to innovate and leading delivery of a complex solution - Excellent verbal and written communication - proven ability to communicate with technical teams and summarise complex analyses in business terms - Ability to work with shifting deadlines in a fast-paced environment Bonus Points - Authoritative in ETL optimisation, designing, coding, and tuning big data processes using Spark - Knowledge of big data architecture concepts like Lambda or Kappa - Experience with streaming workflows to process datasets at low latencies - Experience in managing data - ensuring data quality, tracking lineages, improving data discovery and consumption - Sound knowledge of distributed systems - able to optimise partitioning, distribution and MPP of high-level data structures - Experience in working with large databases, efficiently moving billions of rows, and complex data modelling - Familiarity with AWS is a big plus - Experience in planning day to day tasks, knowing how and what to prioritise and overseeing their execution What's Next... After you submit your application, you can expect the following steps in the recruitment process: 1. Online Preliminary Codility test 2. Recruiter Screening Call 3. Take-home Asse

We are looking to be the one-stop shop for companies that are looking to build world-class teams & place their operations on autopilot. And we’re looking for an Executive Assistant to start immediately! Duties and Responsibilities include but are not limited to: 1. Create and send statements or invoices, track payments, and record company expenses. 2. Ad hoc tasks Qualifications: • Minimum of 3 years of experience as an Executive Assistant to C-levels (CEO, COO etc) • Bachelor's degree or any certificate course (required) • Excellent phone, email, and instant messaging communication skills • Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal (at least B2 level) • Solid organizational & time management skills • Tech savvy & familiar with current technologies, like desktop sharing, cloud services, and VoIP • Experience with word-processing software and spreadsheets (e.g., MS Office) • Knowledge of online calendars and scheduling (e.g., Google Calendar) • Proactive attitude & willingness to be trained • Able to work on a graveyard shift Technical Requirements: • USB Headset with Noise Cancellation feature • Working Webcam • Computer with at least 1.8 GHz processor and at least 4GB RAM • Main Internet Service Speed: at least 25 Mbps cable connection • Backup Internet Service Speed: at least 10 Mbps Benefits: • Health Insurance (HMO) • Performance Incentives • Job Security and Stability • Paid Training • Inclusive Culture • Upskilling Opportunities • 100% Work-From-Home • Exceptionally Supportive Team • Opportunities for Career Growth • Fun Work Environment • Holiday & Overtime Pay Schedule: US work hours (20-40 hours per week) Location: This is a remote job Salary Package (with HMO): • Entry Level (1-3 years of experience): Up to PHP 53,000 • Intermediate Level (3-5 years of experience): Up to PHP 64,000 • Expert Level (5+ years of experience): Up to PHP 80,500 Please note: • Only qualified candidates will be invited to take the assessment & scheduled for an interview. • We have other vacancies that might interest your friends & colleagues. jobgether-jobgether:lever:54168d89-f2d4-.title: Enterprise Account Executive
jobgether-jobgether:lever:54168d89-f2d4-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Enterprise Account Executive based in the United States. This role offers the opportunity to lead strategic enterprise sales within a rapidly evolving AI-powered SaaS environment. You will own a focused portfolio of high-value customers and prospects, driving both expansion and new-logo acquisition. Success will depend on your ability to build executive relationships, navigate complex buying committees, and develop compelling business cases. You will work closely with Customer Success, Business Development, Marketing, and other teams to create coordinated account strategies and pipeline. The position combines consultative selling, strategic account management, commercial negotiation, forecasting, and territory planning. You will also help shape and improve an evolving enterprise sales playbook in a high-growth, builder-oriented environment. It is an ideal opportunity for an experienced SaaS seller who thrives on autonomy, ambitious targets, and transforming established industries through technology. Own a defined portfolio of strategic customer accounts, driving expansion, upselling, cross-selling, and multi-site or enterprise-wide adoption. Partner with Customer Success to develop joint account plans, identify whitespace opportunities, and turn successful customer usage into commercial growth. Build strong relationships with executive stakeholders and position the solution as an enterprise-wide standard rather than a departmental tool. Own a focused list of strategic prospects and drive new-logo acquisition through account-based selling and coordinated outbound strategies. Partner with Business Development and Marketing to execute targeted, multi-touch campaigns that generate qualified enterprise pipeline. Multi-thread across complex buying committees by identifying and engaging economic buyers, champions, technical stakeholders, and other key decision-makers. Conduct detailed account research and deliver tailored, consultative, executive-level demonstrations connected to strategic business outcomes. Own complex negotiations and manage deals through close, ensuring a structured transition to Customer Success and Implementation. Develop strong product, industry, and competitive expertise to communicate differentiated value propositions and defend compelling business cases. Maintain accurate Salesforce records covering pipeline, activities, forecasts, account intelligence, and opportunity progression. Consistently forecast against assigned account metrics and communicate progress, risks, and opportunities to relevant stakeholders. Contribute to the development of repeatable enterprise sales processes by identifying successful approaches, surfacing challenges, and helping codify best practices. Requirements 5+ years of B2B SaaS sales experience, with demonstrated success selling to large and complex organizations. Proven track record managing multi-stakeholder enterprise deals with ACVs of approximately $100K or more and longer sales cycles. Experience selling into and expanding large, multi-site organizations, with confidence engaging senior executives and decision-makers. Consistent history of meeting or exceeding sales quotas while developing strong, trusted customer relationships. Strong expertise in account-based selling, strategic territory planning, pipeline generation, and consultative value-based selling. Ability to develop, articulate, and defend business cases that connect technology investments to measurable business outcomes. Experience with Salesforce or comparable CRM platforms; familiarity with tools such as Gong, Outreach, and ZoomInfo is a plus. Strong written and verbal communication, presentation, organization, follow-up, and negotiation skills. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with Customer Success, Marketing, Business Development, and other cross-fun

jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf8e671d-a4bc-.title: Technical Writer - PostgreSQL
jobgether-jobgether:lever:bf8e671d-a4bc-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Technical Writer - PostgreSQL based in Canada. This is an opportunity to join a distributed open-source software team focused on PostgreSQL and related database technologies. You’ll own the creation of clear, accurate, and user-oriented technical documentation across the product lifecycle. Working closely with engineers, product managers, QA, and fellow technical writers, you’ll turn complex technical concepts into practical resources for diverse audiences. The role combines technical writing, documentation strategy, developer tooling, and hands-on exploration of database systems. You’ll work in a docs-as-code environment and use modern AI tools to improve the speed and quality of your work. With a high degree of autonomy, flexible working hours, and a global team, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys both deep technical work and collaborative open-source environments. Create and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including installation and configuration guides, troubleshooting resources, how-to articles, user manuals, man pages, help prompts, and release documentation. Collaborate closely with Engineering Managers, Product Managers, developers, QA specialists, and other technical writers to produce accurate, timely, and high-quality documentation. Translate complex PostgreSQL and database concepts into clear, accessible content for users with different levels of technical expertise. Use Markdown, text, images, diagrams, and other formats to create engaging and effective documentation. Work within a docs-as-code methodology, maintaining documentation through version-controlled workflows and contributing to scalable documentation practices. Leverage AI-powered tools to draft, refine, structure, format, and improve technical content while maintaining accuracy and quality. Participate actively in team ceremonies, technical discussions, planning sessions, and other collaborative activities. Contribute to the broader documentation strategy and continuously improve writing standards, workflows, and processes. Engage with open-source communities through forums, mailing lists, and other communication channels, sharing knowledge and gathering technical insights. Research new technologies and contribute to upstream documentation, technical blog content, or other knowledge-sharing initiatives when appropriate. Help develop and maintain automated documentation testing, validation processes, and CI/CD workflows where applicable. Requirements: 3+ years of professional experience as a Technical Writer, with a proven ability to produce precise, high-quality technical documentation. Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to explain technical subjects clearly and effectively. Experience documenting complex software systems and producing user-oriented documentation for technical audiences. Strong familiarity with markup languages, particularly Markdown. Hands-on experience installing and configuring database server software on Linux. Practical experience with docs-as-code methodologies and tools such as Git, Jenkins, Markdown, HTML, and/or JavaScript. Experience using AI tools to support technical documentation workflows. Comfortable working with the Linux command line and developer tools such as Git, GCC, and GDB. Understanding of distributed systems and/or database server development. Ability to work independently and manage priorities effectively within a globally distributed organization. Strong collaboration skills and experience communicating through tools such as Slack, Jira, Notion, Zoom, mailing lists, and community forums. Demonstrated ability to learn quickly, solve problems independently, and contribute positively as part of a distributed team. A developer or DevOps background is highly valued. Experience contributing to PostgreSQL or other open-source

jobgether-jobgether:lever:e7b9d948-2c29-.title: Director of Marketing
jobgether-jobgether:lever:e7b9d948-2c29-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Director of Marketing based in Estonia. This is a senior, commercially minded marketing leadership role focused on turning brand awareness into measurable revenue and scalable growth. You will own the full marketing strategy across acquisition, conversion, retention, lifecycle, brand, content, and community. As a player-coach, you will lead the Marketing team while staying close to performance data, creative execution, and optimization. You will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams to support growth and expansion into new markets. The role combines strategic ownership with hands-on execution in a fast-moving, high-growth environment. You will also build the systems, playbooks, and processes needed to scale marketing efficiently across multiple locations. This is an opportunity for a bold, data-driven leader who knows how to build a memorable brand while delivering strong commercial results. Own and evolve the overall marketing strategy across growth, lifecycle, brand, content, and community, translating company growth and revenue objectives into clear priorities, budgets, KPIs, and measurable outcomes. Lead marketing analytics and reporting, maintaining clear visibility into channel performance, customer behavior, acquisition, conversion, retention, and lifetime value. Develop a deep understanding of target customers and use behavioral insights to improve the full customer journey from discovery through purchase, repeat visits, and advocacy. Own profitable customer acquisition and ticket sales across markets, overseeing paid media, SEO, and other growth channels while driving continuous testing and optimization of CAC, ROAS, conversion, and LTV. Oversee e-commerce and digital conversion performance, including landing pages, offers, booking journeys, mobile experiences, and checkout. Build repeatable marketing playbooks for launching and scaling new locations, working closely with Operations to align marketing investment with ticket inventory, seasonality, and market performance. Identify and test new channels, audiences, offers, partnerships, and creative concepts to unlock additional growth opportunities. Own retention and loyalty initiatives across email, SMS, memberships, referrals, reactivation, and other lifecycle programs designed to increase repeat visits, frequency, and customer lifetime value. Use segmentation and customer insights to create relevant, personalized communications and partner with Customer Experience to translate feedback into improvements. Protect and evolve the brand as the business expands, leading content, social, creator, influencer, PR, community, and local activation strategies. Develop campaigns and experiences that generate genuine participation, conversation, sharing, and advocacy across markets. Lead, coach, and develop the Marketing team while maintaining hands-on involvement in execution and performance optimization. Manage agencies, freelancers, and external partners, setting clear expectations and holding them accountable for measurable results. Establish the right balance of internal and external capabilities as the marketing function scales. Build efficient systems, reporting structures, processes, and playbooks that allow Marketing to support significantly more locations without proportional headcount growth. Recruit and develop high-performing marketing talent and establish strong collaboration across Marketing, Operations, Sales, Customer Experience, Technology, and Expansion. Balance long-term brand building with the immediate commercial priorities of a rapidly growing business. Requirements 8+ years of progressive marketing experience, including experience leading, coaching, and developing a marketing team. Proven experience in a consumer-facing, multi-location, DTC, e-commerce, wellness, hospitality, or experience-led business.

southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:7e.title: AI Support Engineer
southparkcommons-cognition-ai:ashbyhq:7e.description: WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer. Our team is extremely talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. WE ARE AN APPLIED AI LAB BUILDING END-TO-END SOFTWARE AGENTS. We're the makers of Devin, the first AI software engineer, and Windsurf, the AI-native IDE. Together, they represent our vision for collaborative AI teammates that enable engineers to focus on more interesting problems and empower teams to strive for more ambitious goals. Our team is small and talent-dense. Among our founding team, we have world-class competitive programmers, former founders, and leaders from companies at the cutting edge of AI including Scale AI, Palantir, Cursor, Waymo, Tesla, Lunchclub, Modal, Google DeepMind, and Nuro. Building Devin and Windsurf is just the first step—our hardest challenges still lie ahead. If you’re excited to solve some of the world’s biggest problems and build AI that can reason on real-world tasks, apply to join us. About the Role Cognition is building the AI software engineer of the future. As an AI Support Engineer, you will be responsible for resolving complex technical issues for customers using Devin and Windsurf in real-world development environments. This role goes well beyond basic support. You will investigate ambiguous, environment-specific problems across codebases, infrastructure, developer tooling, CI/CD systems, APIs, containers, and cloud platforms. You will reproduce bugs, analyze logs, trace failures, form root-cause hypotheses, and drive issues to resolution quickly and rigorously. We are looking for someone with strong debugging instincts, broad systems knowledge, and the ability to operate with urgency across a high volume of technical issues. You should be comfortable context-switching across problem domains, communicating clearly with customers, and partnering closely with engineering when deeper product investigation is required. This is a unique opportunity to work at the frontier of AI-assisted software development, with real customers relying on the product every day.
